## Use case

What are you trying to do, and why doesn't the library support it
today?

## Proposed change

What you'd like added or changed. If you're not sure of the exact
API shape, describe the behavior instead.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you
considered.

---

Note: this library is intentionally small (signing, verification,
and canonical hashing primitives) — see CONTRIBUTING.md's Scope
section. Proposals that add policy evaluation, authorization logic,
or key management/storage are likely out of scope.
